interpretation: Four proposed human rock-chip sampling activities at existing historical sample-context rover proxies. Lunar tool functions inform a Mars planning scenario; no available chip, expected composition, sample mass, duration, safety or Mars-certified hardware is established.

steps: Photograph and describe the selected rock in its outcrop context.
If suitable material is confirmed on site, collect a rock chip with the sampling tools.
Place the chip in an individually labelled container and record its site and photograph references.
Stow the documented sample for later laboratory analysis.
procedure.outcome: A documented rock sample for later laboratory analysis; mineral identity and abundance remain undetermined.
